levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: One or more lines (gross pay, a deduction, or net pay) are mislabeled.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: The learner can explain in their own words what distinguishes a deduction from gross and net pay, not just label them correctly.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Gross pay minus the listed deductions does not equal the stated net pay in the learner's work.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Two specific, well-formed questions for a real payroll/HR contact are included, showing readiness to ask rather than assume.

lookFors: Gross minus deductions equals net exactly in the learner's shown work.
The two payroll/HR questions are specific enough to actually ask someone, not vague.
No claim is made anywhere that this sample predicts a real pay statement's actual figures.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
